record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace 0.8*state+0.2*causal_mean with 0.9*state+0.1*causal_exponential_pool, using fixed half-life eight observed interactions and normalized weights over real prefix positions only. This may retain useful recent context while reducing dilution from older interests. Preserve newest-128 truncation, clipped positions, backbone, embeddings, features, scoring, loss and optimizer. Match training and generated inference; read the final real position at index -1 for left-padded histories.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, use 0.9 times the current state plus 0.1 times a causal exponential pool with an eight-interaction half-life. Normalize over observed prefix positions only. Preserve truncation, clipped positions, backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so it automatically uses the same readout and unchanged checkpoint shapes; its final-position readout remains correct for left padding.
